parts.text: You are provided with two solids: solid L and solid M. Do the following tests on solid L and solid M. Record all of your observations at each stage. Tests on solid L Add about 3 cm depth of distilled water to the boiling tube containing solid L. Replace the stopper in the boiling tube and shake the boiling tube to dissolve solid L and form solution L. Divide solution L into four approximately equal portions in three boiling tubes and one test-tube.

ms.label: 2(a)
ms.text:
M1 white precipitate
M2 effervescence / fizzing / bubbling

ms.label: 2(b)
ms.text:
M1 dropwise: white precipitate
M2 excess: precipitate dissolves

ms.label: 2(c)
ms.text:
M1 dropwise: white precipitate
M2 excess: precipitate remains / no change

ms.label: 2(e)
ms.text:
M1 aluminium / Al
3+
M2 chloride / Cl
-
AlCl3 = 2

parts.label: g
parts.text: (g) Place the remaining solid M in a boiling tube. Add about 5 cm depth of distilled water to the boiling tube. Put a stopper in the boiling tube and shake the boiling tube to dissolve solid M and form solution M. Divide solution M into two approximately equal portions in two boiling tubes.

ms.label: 2(g)(i)
ms.text:
M1 effervescence / bubbles / fizzing
M2 (red) litmus turns blue

ms.label: 2(h)
ms.text:
M1 barium / Ba
2+
M2 nitrate / NO3
-
Ba(NO3)2 = 2
